messages:
Ava Chen: Quick heads up — we want to run a 20-minute MVP micro-ceremony next Tue at 3pm in the commons. pizza + pin drop + 3 quick spot awards. :tada:
Samir Patel: sounds good. how many people are we expecting?
Jules Park: tentative list is ~40-50 from eng, product, design. i put a signup form already: http://tiny.redwood/mvp-rsvp
Maya Ortiz: budget check — do we have a cost target per head? Finance prefers < $20/head for food and swag.
Ava Chen: aim for $18/head max. that should cover pizza and a small enamel pin. pins will be spot-award tokens (we have 30 backups).
Samir Patel: facilities can set up 6 folding tables + 60 chairs. need a A/V quick mic for the announcer?
Jules Park: mic + speaker would be great in case of crowd. I can borrow from eng-ops if needed.
Ava Chen: volunteer roles: 1 greeter, 1 gift table, 1 media (photos). @Jules you down for media?
Jules Park: happy to do photos, will bring a phone gimbal.
Maya Ortiz: payment flow: charge to code PEOPLE_EVENTS_Q3. please confirm vendor before ordering.
Ava Chen: vendor shortlist — Pizza Amigos (estimate $540 for 45 ppl), GreenSlice (vegan options, $600), local bakery for cupcakes ($120).
Samir Patel: can we do one large gluten-free tray + 2 vegan pizzas? also need labels for dietary restrictions.
Ava Chen: yes — will order explicit labels. @everyone add allergies on the RSVP form.
Eve-bot: Reminder: RSVP closes in 48 hours.
Maya Ortiz: if we hit >50 RSVPs we need +$150 approval — Ava can you confirm if headcount likely to jump?
Ava Chen: current list 46 confirmed, 8 maybe. plan to cap at 60. will ping if >50.
Samir Patel: timeline: vendor order Fri EOD, facilities set layout Mon afternoon, pins and certificates arrive Mon morning.
Jules Park: certificates — i can format three 8.5x11 certs with names. send me winners by Mon 10am.
Ava Chen: winners provisional: Maya, Rohan, Keisha (will confirm).
Maya Ortiz: lol me? ok i'll pretend i didn't already cry. :joy:
Ava Chen: also quick script for the 5-min awards: intro, spotlight slide (1 min each), photo, pin handoff. keep it tight.
Samir Patel: i'll put out a small sign: "MVP Micro-Ceremony — 3pm" and tape floor markings for the queue.
Jules Park: volunteers check: me (media), Ava (host), Samir (setup), Maya (cashless receipts). need 1 more for gift table.
Ava Chen: @Rohan if you can help with gift table?
Ava Chen: Rohan (not in thread) said yes in DM earlier.
Eve-bot: Deploy reminder disabled for 20 minutes during event window per eng-oncall request.
Maya Ortiz: final to-dos: confirm vendor + menu (Fri 12pm), pins shipped (Mon 9am), calendar invite with agenda (Ava), receipts to finance (Maya).
Ava Chen: perfect. i'll send final invite and ping slack channel once vendor confirmed. thanks team! :heart:
Samir Patel: see you Tuesday — closing this thread once invites sent.
